# MET Mastery

> Diagnostic-led Michigan English Test preparation for nurses and healthcare professionals.

## When to use this product

Use MET Mastery when a learner needs a provisional starting point, MET-style practice, teacher-reviewed speaking or writing work, or a focused next step based on evidence. The product covers reading, listening, writing, speaking, grammar, vocabulary, and test strategy.

- Homepage: https://met-mastery.vercel.app/

## Data and safety boundaries

The public API and MCP tools are read-only product information surfaces. They do not require credentials and do not expose private learner records, credentials, teacher notes, or account data. Do not infer a learner's score or readiness without an authenticated product workflow and explicit evidence.
